senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (कचते)
1 To bind.
2 To shine.
3 To sound.
(इ) कचि r. 1st cl. (कञ्चते)
1 To shine.
2 To bind; also काचि.

m. (-चः)
1 The hair.
2 A proper name, the son of VṚHASPATI.
3 Binding or a binding.
3 A cicatrix, a dry or healed sore.
5 A cloud.
f. (-चा)
1 A female elephant.
2 Beauty, brilliance.
E.
कच to bind, &c. अच् affix, fem. टाप्.

r. 1st cl. (इ) काचि (काचते)
1 To shine.
2 To bind.

m. (-चः)
1 Alkaline ashes, any salt of potash or soda in a glassy or crystalline state.
2 Crystal, quartz or glass, considered as a natural production, and used as a jewel or ornament.
3 A loop, a swinging shelf, a string so contrived as to hold or support burthens, &c. A disease of the eyes, affection of the optic nerve or gutta serena.
n. (-चं)
1 Alkaline salt, black salt.
2 Wax.
E.
कच to shine or bind, घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
A free market, a place of sale that pays no duty or custom.

m. (-लः)
The ocean.
E.
कच a cloud, अङ्ग the body, and ल what takes or receives.

m. (-पः)
1 Grass.
2 A leaf.
E.
कच a cloud, and प what drinks.

m. (-क्षः)
Much or ornamented hair.
E.
कच hair, and पक्ष, in this combination, abundance; similar compounds are made with पाश and हस्त, कचपाश, कचहस्त; also with केश hair, as केशपक्ष.

m. (-शः)
See the preceding.

m. (-लः)
Smoke.
E.
कच a cloud, and माला a necklace, ड affix; also खतमाल.

n. (-लं)
Black salt or soda: see काचलवण.
E.
काच glass, and मल soil.

f. (-ला)
The Śami tree.

m. (-स्तः)
See कचपक्ष.

mfn. (-कुः-कुः-कु)
1 Ill disposed, wicked.
2 Intolerable, difficult to be borne.
m. (-कुः)
A snake.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Having long or dishevelled hair.
E.
कच, and अचित not gathered.

m. (-रः)
A gallinule.

f. (-चुः)
An esculent root, (Arum colocasia and other kinds, many of which are cultivated for food): see कच्ची.

n. (-टं)
An aquatic plant.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Dirty, foul.
2 Soiled, spoiled by dirt.
3 Vile, wicked, bad.
n. (-रं)
Buttermilk diluted with water.
E.
कुत् bad, vile, चर what goes or is, from चर with अच् affix; कत् is substituted for कत्, and the त changed.

ind.
1 A particle implying wish or desire, (may it be so); also introducing a kind enquiry, (I hope that it is so, &c.)
2 A particle implying an alternative, whether, whether or not.
E.
कत् for कुत् bad, and चित् aff.

ind.
Some one, any one, (a female person or object,) the first member is declinable, as काञ्चित्, &c.
E.
का fem. of किम् and चित् aff.

mfn. (-च्छः-च्छा-च्छं)
Contiguous to water, (land, &c.)
m. (-च्छः)
1 Marshy ground, a marsh, a morass.
2 Ground bordering water or watery soil, as the bank of a river, the margin of a lake or tank, a mound or causeway, &c.
3 Level land skirting mountains.
4 A tree, the timber of which is used for making furniture, &c. commonly Tūn, (Cedrela Tunna, Rox.)
5 Another tree, (Hibiscus Populneoides.)
6 A part of a boat.
mf. (-च्छः-च्छा)
The hem of a garment tucked into the waistband: see कक्ष.
f. (-च्छा)
1 A plant, (Lycopodium imbricatum, Rox.) see वाराही.
2 A cricket.
E.
क water, छो to cut or break, क affix; or कच to bind, छ aff.

f. (-का)
The end or hem of a lower garment or cloth gathered up behind, and tucked into the waistband; also कक्षा and कच्छाटिका.

f. (-का)
See कच्छटिका.

m. (-पः)
1 A turtle, a tortoise.
2 One of KUVERA'S Nidhis or treasures.
3 An attitude in wrestling.
4 A flat kind of still.
f. (-पी)
1 A female tortoise, also a small one.
2 A kind of lute, also the lute of SARASVATĪ.
3 A cutaneous disease, wart or blotch.
E.
कच्छ a morass, and प who cherishes, who inhabits watery places: the lute, &c. are so named from being similar in shape to the tortoise.

f. (-का)
1 A pimple, a blotch or wart.
2 A wart accompanying gonorrhoea.
E.
कच्छप a tortoise, कन् added, fem. form.

f. (-भूः)
Marshy ground, a swamp, a morass.
E.
कच्छ, and भू land.

f. (-हा)
A kind of grass, Dūrvā or Dūb, (Agrostis linearis, Lin., Panicus dactilon, Rox.)
E.
कच्छ marshy ground, and रुह what grows.

m. (-न्तः)
The border of a lake or stream.
E.
कच्छ, and अन्त term.

f. (-च्छुः)
Itch, formation of watery pustules on the hands, &c.
E.
कष to hurt, उ affix; also कच्छू.

f. (-च्छूः)
Scab or itch.
E.
कष to injure, ऊ Uṇādi affix, and छ substituted for ष.

f. (-घ्नी)
A vegetable, (Trichosanthes.)
E.
कच्छु, and ध्नी what removes.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Scabby, itchy.
2 Unchaste, libidinous.
f. (-रा)
1 A plant, (a species of Hedysarum?)
2 Cowach, (Dolichos carpopogon.)
3 Another plant: see शठी.
E.
कच्छ itch or scab, and र aff.

f. (-ती)
Cowach, (Dolichos carpopogon.)
E.
चच्छू itch, and मतुप् affix; producing an itching upon application to the skin.

f. (-का)
The fastening of the lower garment: see कच्छटिका.

f. (-च्ची)
An esculent root, (Arum colocasia and other kinds, several of which are cultivated for food); also written कचु.

(-कः)
1 A stone.
2 Alkaline ashes, &c. see the preceding.
E.
कन added to the last.

f. (-पी)
A glass bottle.
E.
काच, and कूपी bottle.

f. (-टी)
A glass ewer.
E.
काच, and घटी a small jar.

n. (-नं)
An enclosure, a string or tape which ties a parcel or bundle or papers, &c.
E.
कच to tie, ल्युट् affix; also with कन् added काचनक m. (-कः.)

ind.
Some one, any one, (applied to feminine objects,) the first member is declinable.
E.
का fem. of किम, चन added.

n. (-कं)
A binding or rope for binding.
E.
कन् added to काचन.

m. (-की)
A writing, a written paper.
E.
काचनक a binding, and इनि aff.

n. (-नं)
A vessel of glass or crystal, a cup, a goblet, &c.
E.
काच, and भाजन a vessel.

m. (-णिः)
Crystal, quartz.
E.
काच, and मणि a gem.

n. (-णं)
Black salt, a medicinal salt, prepared by calcining fossile salt and the fruit of the emblic myrobalan together. It consists chiefly or muriate of soda, with a small quantity of iron, lime and sulphur, and is a tonic aperient.
E.
काच alkaline ashes, and लवण salt.

n. (-न्त्रं)
A glass retort.
E.
काच, and वकयन्त्र a retort.

n. (-वं)
Black salt: see the last.
E.
काच, and सम्भव produced.

n. (-लं)
Black salt: see काचलवण.
E.
काच, and सौवर्च्चल salt.

f. (-ली)
The trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.)
E.
काच glass, and स्थाली a goblet, &c. to which its colour is compared.

m. (-घः)
1 A legume.
2 A rat.
3 Gold.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Suspended by a swing or in a loop.
E.
काच a nominal root, to hang by a loop or in a swing, and क्त aff.

m. (-मः)
A tree considered as sacred, one growing near a temple, and an object or religious veneration or worship, &c.
